# bahriya_region (Data Source)

Reads one Bahriya region by its identifier, such as `falkenstein-1`. Use the identifier in the `regions` list of a project, container or datastore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bahriya_region" "helsinki" {
  id = "helsinki-1"
}

output "region_name" {
  value = data.bahriya_region.helsinki.name
}

output "region_country" {
  value = data.bahriya_region.helsinki.country
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Region identifier, such as "helsinki-1".

### Read-Only

- `city` (String) City where the region is located.
- `class` (String) Region class, such as "standard".
- `country` (String) Country of the region.
- `description` (String) Human-readable region description.
- `latitude` (Number) Geographic latitude.
- `longitude` (Number) Geographic longitude.
- `name` (String) Region display name.
- `state` (String) State or province of the region.
- `status` (String) Region status, such as "active".
